title: Pelargonidin-3-O-galactoside Alleviates Acute Lung Injury Induced by Klebsiella pneumoniae by Targeting CD38-Mediated Pyroptosis.
authors: Jiang, Fei; Jiang, Jiebang; Sun, Yipeng; Meng, Li; Chen, Jing; Liang, Lulu; Wang, Xueshuang; Zhang, Huiyan; Meng, Mi; Yuan, Bo; He, Sisi; Li, Rongpeng
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 研究天然产物Pg3gal通过CD38/SIRT1/NF-kB/NLRP3通路抑制肺损伤中的细胞焦亡，仅涉及分子对接但非蛋白-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Antibiotic resistance has amplified the threat of bacterial-induced acute lung injury (ALI) to human health. In the quest for novel therapeutic strategies, natural products have shown promise in mitigating the severity of this condition. In this study, we explored the protective effects of pelargonidin-3-O-galactoside (Pg3gal) on Klebsiella pneumoniae (KP)-induced ALI and its underlying mechanisms. Our findings indicated that Pg3gal mitigated lung histopathological changes and edema by inhibiting the migration and infiltration of immune cells and by reducing the secretion of pro-inflammatory cytokines. Molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance analyses revealed that Pg3gal bound to CD38 with high affinity. Further investigation showed that Pg3gal downregulated CD38 expression by promoting its ubiquitination. The reduction of CD38 elevated NAD(+) levels and SIRT1 expression and inhibited NF-kappaB p65 acetylation, thereby suppressing NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis. Our research demonstrates that Pg3gal exerts protective effects against KP-induced ALI by inhibiting pyroptosis through the CD38/SIRT1/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 signaling pathway, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic agent for ALI.
abstract_zh: 抗生素耐药性加剧了细菌诱导的急性肺损伤（ALI）对人类健康的威胁。在探索新型治疗策略的过程中，天然产物显示出减轻该病症严重程度的潜力。在本研究中，我们探讨了花青素-3-O-半乳糖苷（Pg3gal）对肺炎克雷伯菌（KP）诱导的ALI的保护作用及其潜在机制。我们的研究结果表明，Pg3gal通过抑制免疫细胞的迁移和浸润，并减少促炎细胞因子的分泌，减轻了肺组织病理学变化和水肿。分子对接和表面等离子体共振分析显示，Pg3gal与CD38具有高亲和力结合。进一步研究表明，Pg3gal通过促进CD38的泛素化下调其表达。CD38的减少提升了NAD(+)水平和SIRT1表达，并抑制了NF-kappaB p65乙酰化，从而抑制了NLRP3炎症小体介导的细胞焦亡。我们的研究证明，Pg3gal通过CD38/SIRT1/NF-kappaB/NLRP3信号通路抑制细胞焦亡，从而对KP诱导的ALI发挥保护作用，凸显了其作为ALI治疗药物的潜力。
